source: Kölzsch et al. 2015 three Movebank archived GPS records (original 2014 DOI deposits); not the manuscript supporting information
method: Use exact registered DataCite DOI->DSpace source title and original handle mapping, require original public MD5 metadata and size, fetch only exactly one <=20000 byte .csv and one <=20000 byte .txt for each of three cohorts. No selected tracking/event large CSVs are fetched.
fail_closed: Item title flyway, DOI or handle drift
Source original bundle or small reference file not unique
Readme size or metadata CSV size differs from frozen original file manifest
HTTP 200 not original registered same-host source
Original file byte count or DSpace MD5 mismatch
A candidate filename or file metadata reveals the selected CSV is an event/track/GPS member; never let file-size-only choose it
output_only: cohort ID, metadata file extension, exact size, verified original MD5 Boolean and SHA256 digest of source bytes
reference CSV header field names, source row count, number of distinct tag-id/animal-id if explicitly present, never identifier strings
README presence Boolean for GPS, timestamp, historical climate, GDD, UTC, spring onset, license
Does the small reference CSV itself carry 1982–2011 source-target spring onset anomalies? Only exact schema recognition, no materialization/imputation.
legal: Original Svalbard data are CC BY-NC 4.0; do not treat all 3 as CC0; source processing is academic noncommercial, retain citations.
